morgan: Heads up — noticed a customer (acct 78434) is slowly hitting quota despite low QPS. Looks like repeated toolcall truncation/resume is nibbling tokens; dashboard shows +8-12 tokens every few seconds for ~2h :eyes:

alex: can you paste an example trace / request id?

morgan: sure, here's a tiny log slice showing the sequence (same session, multiple short charges):
```
2026-03-20T14:02:33Z req=abc123 session=se-78 toolcall=tc-1 action=truncate charged=9
2026-03-20T14:02:35Z req=abc124 session=se-78 toolcall=tc-1 action=resume charged=3
2026-03-20T14:02:40Z req=abc125 session=se-78 toolcall=tc-1 action=truncate charged=7
```
looks like our charging path counts each partial chunk as confirmed. customer sees steady drain.

jin: this rings a bell — we had an earlier provisional-credit vs confirmed-charge gap for streaming toolcalls. two quick approaches:
1) dedupe at billing by canonicalizing toolcall IDs across trunc/resume (harder rollout)
2) add lightweight provenance metadata to the internal RPCs so billing/console can detect and group related partial charges (safer, faster)
I lean 2 for telemetry + short-term fix.

jin: proposed header (internal only):
```
X-Charge-Provenance: session:se-78|toolcall:tc-1|stage:resume|reason:truncation
```
we can parse/hash this at the ledger layer to attribute to one logical op.

priya: UX ask: Console needs a "provisional vs confirmed" toggle for route dashboards and a per-request breadcrumb that surfaces the provenance string. Ops teams want to be able to filter by provenance_hash to spot quota-grazers.

sam: caution: adding free-form provenance increases cardinality. ops suggestion: compute a short hash server-side (e.g. sha1(provenance)[:8]) and emit metric tag charge.provenance_hash=<hex>. keep full provenance in trace logs only and sample (1% non-enterprise, 100% for affected incs).

morgan: sounds good. i'll prototype the header + ledger-side hash + a small dashboard tile: sum(charged) by provenance_hash over 1h vs confirmed_charge. if the gap narrows we can avoid canonicalization. will open RFC + test plan.

alex: include migration plan if we ever canonicalize toolcall ids. we can't break older SDKs that append suffixes. RFC should include rollout flag and CLI toggles for Dedicated customers.
